question: As of May 2022, which of the following is NOT a part of Article 19 of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: To assemble peaceably and without arms
To move freely throughout the territory of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Right to Property.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Article 19 **of the Indian Constitution** guarantees six freedoms to the citizens of India.**

 
• Freedom of speech and expression.
 
• Freedom to assemble peaceably and without arms.
 
• Freedom to form associations or unions.
 
• Freedom to move freely throughout the territory of India.
